title: Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography
abstract: arXiv:2610.23315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered. A regularized data-driven framework is proposed in which the unknown fields are represented in finite-dimensional wavelet spaces and fixed nonlinear features generated by an untrained convolutional neural network (CNN) are used to reconstruct the initial-pressure coefficients through Tikhonov-regularized least squares. A learned coefficient-space prior is subsequently used to infer the squared sound-speed coefficients. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction on held-out data and strong generalization to previously unseen phantom geometries. The frozen reconstruction map also remains stable under measurement noise not represented during training, with only minor changes in reconstruction accuracy for noise levels up to $10\%$. translated_title: 基于未训练CNN与系数空间正则化的光声层析成像联合重建
translated_abstract: 本文考虑了从边界测量数据中对光声层析成像中的初始压力和空间变化声速进行联合重建的问题。提出了一种正则化数据驱动框架，其中未知场在有限维小波空间中表示，并利用由未训练卷积神经网络（CNN）生成的固定非线性特征，通过Tikhonov正则化最小二乘法重建初始压力系数。随后使用学习到的系数空间先验来推断平方声速系数。数值实验表明，该方法在保留数据上实现了精确重建，并对先前未见的模体几何形状具有很强的泛化能力。冻结的重建映射在训练中未出现的测量噪声下也保持稳定，对于高达10%的噪声水平，重建精度仅有轻微变化。与有监督训练的CNN相比……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于未训练CNN固定非线性特征与系数空间正则化的数据驱动框架，实现了光声层析成像中初始压力与空间变化声速的联合重建，具有强泛化能力和噪声鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a regularized data-driven framework using fixed nonlinear features from an untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization to jointly reconstruct initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography, achieving strong generalization and robustness to unseen measurement noise.
